find: return { radius: reducedMotion ? 1 : 2.4 - 1.4 * p, opacity: p, arc: 1 };
replace: return { radius: reducedMotion ? 1 : 1 + 1.4 * p, opacity: p, arc: 1 };
why: The direction of the shared entrance ring flipped back, so every style's arrival grows outward again, exactly like the death pulse it is told apart from (issue #230's complaint, which issue #1120 answered by shipping the converging ring). The flipped ring (1.0 -> 2.4) still appears and still brightens, so nothing but its direction, and with it the reading, separates the two builds.
killedBy: converge: an arrival gathers instead of expanding (issue #230) every style converges
